invariant: i ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < i → a[k]! < key

lemmas.name: exit51
lemmas.statement: ∀ (a : Array Int) (key : Int) (i : Nat) (h : BinarySearch_precond a key), (i ≤ a.size ∧ ∀ k, k < i → a[k]! < key) → ¬ (i < a.size ∧ a[i]! < key) → BinarySearch_postcond a key i h
lemmas.proof:
by intro a key i h hinv hn
  obtain ⟨hi, hk⟩ := hinv
  have hs := Refine.sorted_arr_le a h
  unfold BinarySearch_postcond
  refine ⟨hi, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Refine.arr_all_take_iff]; intro k hk1 _; simpa using hk k hk1
  · rw [Refine.arr_all_drop_iff]; intro k hk1 hk2
    have hlt : i < a.size := by omega
    have h1 : ¬ a[i]! < key := fun hx => hn ⟨hlt, hx⟩
    have h2 := hs i k hk1 hk2
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]; omega
